title: Dynamic Type as the base, reader slider as a relative offset
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Accessibility > Dynamic Type as the base
acceptance: Every .system(size:) call site in Stacks and StacksShareExtension is replaced with a Dynamic Type equivalent
The reader's slider becomes a relative offset via UIFontMetrics or Font.custom(size:relativeTo:)
The reader is usable at Accessibility XL before any control is touched
notes: Close to disqualifying for low-vision users today. Touches nearly every view — will monopolise the touches lock, so schedule it alone.
